# A New Beginning Church

> A Spirit-led, non-denominational Christian church in Rushville, Indiana. Sunday worship at 10:30 AM, plus weekly midweek gatherings.

A New Beginning Church is a small, family-sized congregation in Rushville, IN led by Pastor Mark Mathews. The church is anchored in Scripture and alive in the Gifts of the Spirit (1 Corinthians 12). Visitors are welcomed by name and walked through their first visit.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Service times, location, what to expect, plan a visit.
- [About](/about): The church's story, what we believe, and the leaders you'll meet on Sunday.
- [Events](/events): Monthly calendar of Sunday worship, women's study, Bible discussion, and prayer night.
- [Watch](/watch): Latest sermon and link to the YouTube archive.
- [Resources](/resources): Helpful next-step links for visitors and members.
